decisionReason: Exact-head locked Windows run 31316863680 completed successfully and proved the candidate boundary, 12/12 bend custody and target-node equilibrium, but the isolated system cutover does not satisfy M047 promotion gates. It improves L19 node 20090 FY from 8.542% to 5.747% relative error, reduces L19 displacement/rotation RMSnorm from 0.34639 to 0.32300, and reduces L19 source-action failures 23 -> 21 with RMSnorm 0.05304 -> 0.05241. However it creates a new L19 restraint failure at node 20390 FZ (9.961% -> 10.524%), increases L19 displacement failures 66 -> 67, and materially regresses L20: restraints 6 -> 7, displacement/rotation failures 90 -> 92, source-end-action failures 134 -> 171, with all three L20 RMS metrics worsening. The new L19 restraint lies downstream of bend sources 19/20 whose incoming-straight carriers changed while their arcs were intentionally frozen. Equilibrium remains numerical roundoff, so this is a mechanics-boundary result rather than recovery imbalance. The physical proposition that bend incoming straights require the common base-beam law remains plausible, but I021 proves that promoting only this carrier family on top of I015 is not an acceptable system architecture. Any future bend promotion must qualify incoming-straight and curved-pipe ownership coherently while keeping tee/reducer ownership separate.
